content: Teɨteri tuxiyu kememɨte'utawewi
Merikɨtsɨ mɨkɨ tukaritsie teɨteri xeiniukiyari xeikɨa mekanexeiyakaitɨni naitsarie kwiepa.
Hikɨ mehekɨneka tau manatineika hepatsie, mekanitaxeiya hakuwerime Tsinaxi kwieyaritsie, mana mekanikuyaxe.

Hikɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniuxata: «Kiekari tepɨkamani xeime tuxiyu hexeiyakame muyuawitsie heuti'akame, xɨnariya tepɨtiwewieni tepititaiya. Mɨpaɨ teteyurieyu 'aixɨa tepɨtexeiyarieni, meta tepɨkataxɨriyaxɨani naitsarie kwiepa». 'Ana xɨnariya mekaniuyurieni tetexi mɨkaxuawekaikɨ, kwetsɨka mɨyɨwi mekaniuyurieni mana kwieta matineikakaikɨ tsepa haxu muxuawekai.
Hikɨ Yawé kaniukateni kiekari mɨxeiyakɨ meta tuxiyu teɨteri memiwewietɨwekaikɨ,
mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Yunaitɨ mepɨxeikiekariyari meta xeiniukiyari xeikɨa mepexeiya, 'ayumieme mɨkɨ 'uximayatsika meputsutɨa, kememɨtexata yamepɨteyurieni.
Matsi 'aixɨa pɨyɨni waniuki nepɨpataxɨani, memɨkayu'eniekakɨri yunaitɨ».
Mɨpaɨ Yawé waruyurieku mekaneutayeixɨani naitsarie kwiepa, mekateniuhayewata me'iwewietɨwetɨ kiekari.
'Ayumieme mɨkɨ kiekari Waweri katiniuterɨwarieni, mana Yawé waniuki kaniupataxɨani teɨteri kwiepa memɨtama yunaime memɨkayu'eniekakɨ, manata yaxeikɨa naitsarie mɨwareutaxɨriexɨakɨ.
Tsemi nuiwarimama
'Ikɨ Tsemi nuiwarimama wa'ɨxatsi kanihɨkɨtɨni: Kepauka teɨteri memutihau huta wiyari 'anuyemiekaku kepauka Tsemi xeitsienituyari mexeiyakai, 'ana nu'aya 'Axipatsari kaniutinuiwa.
'Axipatsari 'utinuiwaku Tsemi kaniutihuni 'akuxi 'auxɨwime tsienituyari wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka 'Axipatsari xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwime wiyari mexeiyakai, niweya Tseraki kaniutinuiwa.
Tseraki 'utinuiwaku, 'Axipatsari kaniutihuni 'akuxi nauka tsienituyari heimana haika wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka Tseraki xeitewiyari heimana tamamata wiyari mexeiyakai, niweya 'Ewexi kaniutinuiwa.
'Ewexi 'utinuiwaku Tseraki kaniutihuni 'akuxi nauka tsienituyari heimana haika wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka 'Ewexi xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana nauka wiyari mexeiyakai, niweya Pereki kaniutinuiwa.
Pereki 'utinuiwaku 'Ewexi kaniutihuni 'akuxi nauka tsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka Pereki xeitewiyari heimana tamamata wiyari mexeiyakai, niweya Xehu kaniutinuiwa.
Xehu 'utinuiwaku Pereki kaniutihuni 'akuxi huta tsienituyari heimana 'atanauka wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka Xehu xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana huta wiyari mexeiyakai, niweya Tseruki kaniutinuiwa.
Tseruki 'utinuiwaku Xehu kaniutihuni 'akuxi huta tsienituyari heimana 'atahuta wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka Tseruki xeitewiyari heimana tamamata wiyari mexeiyakai, niweya Nakuxi kaniutinuiwa.
Nakuxi 'utinuiwaku Tseruki kaniutihuni 'akuxi huta tsienituyari wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka Nakuxi xeitewiyari heimana 'atanauka wiyari mexeiyakai, niweya Teraki kaniutinuiwa.
Teraki 'utinuiwaku Nakuxi kaniutihuni 'akuxi xeitsienituyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atanauka wiyari, tawarita warayexeiyaka 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Kepauka Teraki haika tewiyari heimana tamamata wiyari mexeiyakai, mekaniutinunuiwakaitɨniri niwemama 'Apɨrami, Nakuxi, Karani.
Teraki nuiwarimama
'Ikɨ Teraki kemuyɨ 'ɨxatsieya kanihɨkɨtɨni, 'Apɨrami, Nakuxi meta Karani wapaapa. Karani Ruti pupaapayatɨkai,
Karani kaniumɨni 'Uxi karireutsixi wakwieyaritsie, matinuiwaxɨtsie, paapaya Teraki 'ayeyurikaku 'akuxi.
'Apɨrami Tsarahi kaniutiwitɨni, meta Nakuxi Mirika kaniutiwitɨni Karani niweya, mɨkɨ tawarita xeime 'uka kanayexeiya 'Itsika titewakame.
Perutsɨ Tsarahi pɨkaniwewekai, pɨkayɨwekai tɨɨri mɨwarayexeiya.

Teraki kanayeyani 'Uxi karireutsixi wakwieyaritsie Kanani 'uta'eriwatɨ. Yuniwe 'Apɨrami 'awitɨtɨ meta yuteukari Ruti, meta yumu'e Tsarahi 'Apɨrami 'ɨyaya. Peru Karani kiekariyaritsie me'u'axɨaka mana mekanikuyaxe,
mana Teraki kaniumɨni huta tsienituyari heimana 'auxɨwime wiyari hexeiyatɨ.
